messages:
elaine: Quick follow-up from the incident review earlier — I captured a short action checklist we need to kick off for RBAC, KMS, and audit logging. Spreading tasks so we can close the gaps before the next tabletop.

raj: thanks. can you paste the checklist here so i can assign?

elaine: Yep. High level first: 1) privilege sweep for service accounts used by ingestion pipeline, 2) verify audit log retention and forwarding to SIEM for the time window we missed, 3) KMS key rotation plan for the affected keys (and verify usage in dedicated deploys), 4) update runbook with explicit containment steps we tripped on, 5) schedule a small tabletop with infra + product to validate comms.

samir: re (1) — i can run a quick IAM report and flag any roles with wildcards. plan to run tomorrow morning.

jess: for (2) — which retention window are we standardizing on? current incident showed a gap for 72h of logs.

elaine: We should align on 90 days for access/audit events and 365 days for admin/audit-change events (company policy draft). For the immediate action make sure the SIEM ingestion backfill for the missing 72h is kicked.

raj: tagging ops: @sec-bot can you confirm whether the backfill job was started?

sec-bot: audit-backfill-job-317 enqueued by raj at 1847660100. status: queued. :warning:

dylan: i'll pick up the backfill if it needs manual scope. sending a quick query to see which streams are missing.

elaine: about KMS — we found two service accounts still referencing the old key alias. action: rotate keys and update aliases, then run smoke on private deploys to ensure decryption paths are fine. samir, can you coordinate with infra for the rotation window?

samir: yes. propose maintenance window Friday 02:00 UTC. I'll draft runbook steps.

jess: for RBAC changes, recommend we do a staged privilege sweep: stage 1 = report only, stage 2 = remove excessively permissive bindings in non-prod, stage 3 = apply to prod with change freeze. Need a checklist of owners.

elaine: Agreed. Owners draft: samir -> service account audit + rotation plan; raj -> RBAC report + staged changes; jess -> audit retention + SIEM backfill; dylan -> deploy smoke tests and rolling verification; me -> runbook updates + tabletop organizer.

raj: i created tickets: INF-842 (svcacct-priv-sweep), SEC-511 (audit-backfill + retention), KMS-276 (rotate-affected-keys). please add owners and ETA.

elaine: great. small note on runbook updates — add the explicit fallback model when KMS rotation fails: revert to previous alias, requeue pending requests, and notify customer-facing channels. include exact commands. example snippet:

```
# rollback alias
aws kms update-alias --alias-name alias/service-primary --target-key-id <previous-key-id>
# requeue pending decrypt jobs
/opt/redwood/bin/requeue_decrypt --queue pending-decrypts
```

samir: will add those commands to the runbook. also adding a pre-rotation checklist to validate no active long-running jobs are using the key.

dylan: tabletop: suggest 60m with scenario reproduction of an ingestion auth fail plus KMS issue. product and support should join to practice external comms. propose Tue 09:00 PDT.

elaine: Tue 09:00 PDT works for me. i'll send invites and include the doc with the new runbook draft.

jess: small policy ask — can we harden binder roles so that new service accounts get restricted by default? i can draft a PR to the provisioning templates.

raj: yes please. make it opt-out with clear exception flow. that should reduce a lot of blast radius.

elaine: final: let's set target dates: report-only RBAC sweep by Wed EOD, KMS rotation plan by Thu EOD, SIEM backfill started within 24h. I'll put these in the incident action tracker.

samir: noted. starting IAM report now.

sec-bot: ticket updates: INF-842 assigned to raj, SEC-511 assigned to jess, KMS-276 assigned to samir. status: open. :thumbsup:

elaine: thanks all. quick check-in tomorrow 10:30 to confirm progress. If anything blocks earlier ping here and DM me. :wave:
